defects_argued.quote: He submits that the Show Cause Notices are normally uploaded on the portal under the heading of ‘Notices’, however, in the instant case it appears that the Show Cause Notice was uploaded on the portal in the category of ‘Additional Notices’ which were not easily accessible, and accordingly skipped the attention of the Petitioner.

outcome.quote: With these observations, the petition is disposed of, along with pending application(s), if any.
